subject.title: feat: configure metadata (contextWindow, maxTokens, etc.) for custom provider setup

question: Should `openclaw configure --section model` add an interactive custom-provider metadata editing step after the lossless metadata blockers are repaired?
rationale: The code blockers are mechanical, but the PR changes a public setup flow and overlaps the broader canonical onboarding metadata issue, so final acceptance depends on maintainer UX direction.

options.title: Accept After Lossless Repairs
options.body: Land the wizard only after it preserves unedited modalities, pricing, and API adapter metadata with focused reconfigure coverage.

options.title: Narrow To Token Metadata
options.body: Limit this PR to context-window and max-token prompts and defer API, modality, and pricing editing to a later design.

options.title: Defer To Canonical Issue
options.body: Pause or close this PR and handle the interactive prompt surface through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/61716.

recommendation.title: Accept After Lossless Repairs
recommendation.body: Land the wizard only after it preserves unedited modalities, pricing, and API adapter metadata with focused reconfigure coverage.
